name: Tenacity in the Arcatraz

date.label: Original Burning Crusade attunement quest era; exact date unknown

summary: At the Arcatraz, A’dal’s account turns the trial toward persistence. The naaru have imprisoned dangerous beings aboard Tempest Keep, but A’dal distinguishes Millhouse: a gnome stowaway caught on the wrong vessel at the wrong moment. The adventurer must rescue him and ensure he survives. That account of how Millhouse came to be imprisoned belongs to A’dal’s quest text; the story does not turn it into an independent capture report.
